name: Famine
summary: IPC warns of growing famine risk in Darfur and Kordofan; El Niño drought adds risk
state: An IPC alert on 12 Oct warned of a growing risk of famine in parts of Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan, where drought affects about half of Sudan (WHO). FEWS NET warns that El Niño drought will deepen hunger in East and southern Africa into 2027. No current IPC Phase 5 classification was confirmed as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Humanitarian appeals from WFP, UNICEF and other UN agencies list how to support affected populations.
rubric_hit: Risk-of-famine alerts = Watch; no current Phase 5 confirmed

sources.title: WHO — IPC Sudan food insecurity and malnutrition alert
FEWS NET — 2026–2027 El Niño food security impacts

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
